verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.mangopay.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an explicit 'Instructions for AI Agents' section. First-party docs include a 'Build with AI' page stating that any page is available as clean Markdown by appending `.md`, and a machine-readable openapi.json is also served. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs, and evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is (e.g. an llms-full.txt).
